stem: 【听力·短对话】听辨要点：女：Have you finished the book I lent you last week? 男：Not yet. I've only read half of it because I've had too much homework to do. 问题：What do we learn about the man? A. He has returned the book. B. He has finished reading the whole book. C. He has read half of the book. D. He has no homework to do.
options: A. He has returned the book.
B. He has finished reading the whole book.
C. He has read half of the book.
D. He has no homework to do.
solution: 听辨关键句："I've only read half of it"。该句直接表明男士仅读了一半书本，对应选项 C。其它选项与原文相反或不符。

stem: 【听力·短对话】听辨要点：女：When will the meeting begin? 男：It was supposed to start at 9, but the manager called to say he'd be twenty minutes late. 问题：When will the meeting begin? A. At 8:40. B. At 9:00. C. At 9:20. D. At 9:40.
solution: 原计划 9:00 开始，经理迟到 20 分钟，即 9:20 开始。听力细节题关键是数字计算，故选 C。

stem: 【听力·短对话·语调辨义】听辨要点：男：So you really think we should tell her the truth?（升调）女：Of course. Honesty is the best policy, after all. 问题：What does the woman mean? A. She disagrees with telling the truth. B. She thinks honesty is sometimes wrong. C. She strongly agrees with telling the truth. D. She has no idea to pay.
options: A. She disagrees with telling the truth.
B. She thinks honesty is sometimes wrong.
C. She strongly agrees with telling the truth.
D. She has no idea to pay.
solution: 男士用升调确认，女士回答"Of course"加强语气，并补充"Honesty is the best policy"，表赞同。语调辨义与语义结合，选 C。

stem: 【听力·长对话·信息记录】听辨要点：女：Good morning, Sunshine Library. How can I help you? 女：Yes, I'd like to reserve a study room for Saturday afternoon. 女：Certainly. For how many people? 女：Four. We'd like it from 2 to 4 p.m. if possible. 女：Let me check… I'm sorry, 2 to 4 is booked. How about 3 to 5? 女：That's fine. My name is Linda Green. 请按听辨要点填入：Name: ___________ ; Party size: ___________ ; Reserved time: ___________ .
solution: 听填关键信息：自报姓名 Linda Green；人数 4 人；时间因 2-4 已订改为 3-5 p.m.。听填题关键是边听边记姓名/数字。

stem: 【听力·长对话】听辨要点：男：I heard you went on a trip to Zhangjiajie last month. 女：Yes, it was wonderful. The mountains were covered in mist, and we stayed in a small inn near the national park. 男：Sounds great. How long did you stay? 女：Just four days, but I wish we could have stayed longer. 问题：What is the woman mainly talking about? A. A business trip. B. A holiday trip. C. A study tour. D. A family visit.
options: A. A business trip.
B. A holiday trip.
C. A study tour.
D. A family visit.
solution: 主旨题：女士谈到 Zhangjiajie 旅游感受和住宿，主旨为一次假期旅游，选 B。

stem: 【听力·独白】听辨要点：The Spring Festival Gala has been broadcast on Chinese New Year's Eve for over forty years. Every year, hundreds of millions of people sit in front of their TVs to watch it together. Although some viewers say the show has become less exciting in recent years, it remains a tradition that brings families together. 问题：What is the speaker mainly discussing? A. The history of TV. B. The Spring Festival Gala. C. Chinese New Year food. D. Modern Chinese families.
options: A. The history of TV.
B. The Spring Festival Gala.
C. Chinese New Year food.
D. Modern Chinese families.
solution: 独白首句点出主题——Spring Festival Gala，主旨即春晚这一传统节目。选 B。

Volunteer English Tutors Needed
The Community Library is looking for English tutors to help children aged 8 to 12 on Saturday mornings from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m. Tutors should be patient, friendly and able to speak clear English. Each tutor will work with a small group of four to six children. A short training session will be provided on the first Saturday. If you are interested, please contact Ms. Liu at liu@library.org before Friday, October 18.
问题：Who is the notice intended for? A. Parents of children aged 8 to 12. B. English teachers from local schools. C. People who want to teach English to children for free. D. Children who want to improve their English.
options: A. Parents of children aged 8 to 12.
B. English teachers from local schools.
C. People who want to teach English to children for free.
D. Children who want to improve their English.

stem: 【阅读理解A·应用文·续】根据上文通告，问题：How many children will each tutor work with at most? A. Four. B. Five. C. Six. D. Eight.
options: A. Four.
B. Five.
C. Six.
D. Eight.
solution: 细节题：通告中"work with a small group of four to six children"，最多 6 人，选 C。

【阅读理解B·记叙文】
When I was ten, my grandfather gave me a small wooden boat he had carved by hand. "Every great journey starts with a single push," he told me, smiling. I kept the boat on my desk for years and, although I never sailed it, it always reminded me of him. After he passed away, I finally placed the boat on a shelf where I could see it every day. Now, whenever I face a difficult choice, I remember his words and find the courage to move forward.
问题：Why did the writer keep the boat on his desk? A. He wanted to learn to sail. B. He used it as a pencil holder. C. It reminded him of his grandfather. D. It was a gift from his friend.
options: A. He wanted to learn to sail.
B. He used it as a pencil holder.
C. It reminded him of his grandfather.
D. It was a gift from his friend.
solution: 细节题：文中"it always reminded me of him"即祖父，对应 C。

stem: 【阅读理解B·记叙文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What can we infer about the writer's grandfather? A. He was a sailor by profession. B. He cared about the writer and wanted to encourage him. C. He disliked carving wooden objects. D. He had travelled all over the world.
options: A. He was a sailor by profession.
B. He cared about the writer and wanted to encourage him.
C. He disliked carving wooden objects.
D. He had travelled all over the world.
solution: 推断题：祖父亲自手刻木船并赠言鼓励，可推断他关爱作者并希望鼓励他成长，故选 B。

stem:
【阅读理解C·说明文】
The Amazon rainforest, often called "the lungs of the Earth", produces roughly 6 percent of the world's oxygen and stores huge amounts of carbon. However, in recent decades, large areas have been cleared for farming and cattle raising. Scientists warn that if the current rate of deforestation continues, the rainforest could turn into a dry savanna by the end of this century, which would release enormous amounts of carbon dioxide and speed up global warming.
问题：What is the main idea of the passage? A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth". B. How oxygen is produced in the forest. C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing. D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.
options: A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth".
B. How oxygen is produced in the forest.
C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing.
D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.
solution: 主旨题：首段介绍亚马逊雨林作用，次段重点讲砍伐带来的风险，主旨为亚马逊雨林正在面临的危险，选 C。

stem: 【阅读理解C·说明文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What may happen if deforestation goes on? A. The rainforest will become larger. B. More oxygen will be produced. C. The rainforest may become a dry savanna. D. Global temperatures will drop sharply.
options: A. The rainforest will become larger.
B. More oxygen will be produced.
C. The rainforest may become a dry savanna.
D. Global temperatures will drop sharply.
solution: 细节定位：第二句"the rainforest could turn into a dry savanna"，故选 C。

stem: 【阅读理解C·说明文·词义猜测】根据上文短文，问题：The word "deforestation" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ________. A. planting trees in a forest B. cutting down trees in a large area C. protecting forests from fire D. counting the trees in a forest
options: A. planting trees in a forest
B. cutting down trees in a large area
C. protecting forests from fire
D. counting the trees in a forest
solution: 词义猜测题：根据构词法 de-forest-ation（去+森林+名词后缀）及"large areas have been cleared"语境，清楚并对应 B。

stem:
【阅读理解D·议论文】
Some people argue that students should be allowed to use their smartphones in class because the devices can be used as powerful learning tools. However, studies have shown that students who use phones in class often get lower grades than those who do not, mainly because they are easily distracted by social media and games. In my opinion, smartphones should be banned in class, but schools should set up special areas where students can use them for study purposes.
问题：What is the author's attitude toward using smartphones in class? A. Strongly supportive. B. Somewhat supportive. C. Neutral. D. Against, but with controlled use.
options: A. Strongly supportive.
B. Somewhat supportive.
C. Neutral.
D. Against, but with controlled use.
solution: 态度题：作者明确主张"smartphones should be banned in class"，但同时建议"special areas where students can use them for study"，故选 D：反对但可控使用。

stem: 【阅读理解D·议论文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What can be inferred from the passage? A. Smartphones always lower students' grades. B. Smartphones should be completely banned in schools. C. Smartphones can be useful if used properly. D. Social media has no influence on students.
options: A. Smartphones always lower students' grades.
B. Smartphones should be completely banned in schools.
C. Smartphones can be useful if used properly.
D. Social media has no influence on students.
solution: 推断题：作者承认手机可作学习工具，但要有使用场景限制，故选 C。

【七选五·段落还原】
How to Keep a Good Mood Every Day?
① ___ . When you wake up in the morning, taking a few deep breaths and stretching your body can help you feel more awake and relaxed.
② ___ . A simple smile, even when you are not happy, can trick your brain into releasing chemicals that lift your mood.
③ ___ . Doing exercise, even just a short walk, causes your body to produce endorphins, which are natural mood lifters.
④ ___ . Talking with friends or family about your worries can make problems seem smaller and easier to solve.
⑤ ___ . A balanced diet with enough fruits and vegetables gives your brain the energy it needs to stay positive.
A. Share your feelings with people you trust
B. Choose healthy food
C. Start the day with simple exercise
D. Use a smile to change your mood
E. Exercise regularly
F. Listen to your favourite music
G. Get enough sleep at night
options: A. Share your feelings with people you trust
B. Choose healthy food
C. Start the day with simple exercise
D. Use a smile to change your mood
E. Exercise regularly
F. Listen to your favourite music
G. Get enough sleep at night
solution: 七选五题号与五段内容对应：① 早起深呼吸 → C；② 微笑 → D；③ 运动 → E；④ 与人倾诉 → A；⑤ 健康饮食 → B。剩余 F、G 为多余干扰项。

B. Choose healthy food.
C. Start the day with simple exercise.
D. Use a smile to change your mood.
solution: ① 段尾"taking a few deep breaths and stretching your body"对应 C 项"Start the day with simple exercise"。

stem:
【完形填空】
Last weekend, our class went on a trip to a farm. We ___1___ at 7 a.m. and took a school bus there. When we arrived, the farmer gave us a warm ___2___ and showed us around the farm. In the morning, we picked apples and fed the chickens. Some of us were a bit nervous because we had never been ___3___ to farm animals before. At noon, we had a picnic lunch under a big tree. The food tasted ___4___ because we were all hungry after the hard work. In the afternoon, we ___5___ a video on how milk is produced. Although we were tired, everyone had a ___6___ time. We learned a lot and made some new friends.
① A. set off  B. set up  C. set down  D. set on
② A. welcome  B. welcomes  C. welcoming  D. welcomed
③ A. close  B. closely  C. closer  D. closest
④ A. well  B. good  C. great  D. better
⑤ A. watched  B. look  C. read  D. noticed
⑥ A. difficulty  B. difficult  C. wonderful  D. wonder
options: A. set off / welcome / close / well / watched / difficulty
B. set up / welcomes / closely / good / look / difficult
C. set off / welcome / close / great / watched / wonderful
D. set on / welcomed / closest / better / read / wonder
solution: 完形填空题：① set off 出发；② welcome 名词欢迎；③ close 亲近的；⑤ watched 观看；⑥ wonderful 美妙的；④ great 是 C 项，最贴合疲惫后吃上饭的美味感受，故完整答案为 A-A-A-C-A-C（注：用户提供的选项已整合为 A/B/C/D 整体选项，本题选 C：set off / welcome / close / great / watched / wonderful）。

stem:
【完形填空】
Mr. Brown is a famous scientist ___1___ has spent most of his life studying climate change. He believes that the earth ___2___ we live on is changing faster than ever. His team, ___3___ consists of ten young researchers from different countries, has published many important papers. They have found that the ice in the Arctic ___4___ about 13 percent every ten years, which worries people all over the world. Mr. Brown often says, "We must act now, ___5___ it will be too late for our children."
① A. that  B. which  C. who  D. whom
③ A. that  B. which  C. who  D. whom
④ A. has reduced  B. has been reduced  C. is reducing  D. reduces
⑤ A. and  B. but  C. or  D. so
options: A. that / which / that / has reduced / and
B. who / on which / which / has been reduced / or
C. which / where / who / has been reduced / or
D. whom / that / which / is reducing / but
solution: 完形填空：① who 引导限制性定语从句指人；② on which（= on the earth）介词前置；③ which 引导非限制性定语从句指代 His team；④ has been reduced 被动语态（冰在减少）；⑤ or 否则。综合选 B。

stem: 【完形填空·续上题】回顾上文，关于 Mr. Brown 的团队，下列哪一描述是正确的？A. The team has only one member. B. The team is made up of ten young researchers. C. The team members are all from China. D. The team studies only medicine.
options: A. The team has only one member.
B. The team is made up of ten young researchers.
C. The team members are all from China.
D. The team studies only medicine.
solution: 细节题：根据"consists of ten young researchers from different countries"，正确答案为 B：团队由十位来自不同国家的年轻研究者组成。

stem:
【语法填空·提示词】用所给词的适当形式填空（每空一词）。
The students in our class are working hard ___1___ (prepare) for the coming English speech contest. Mr. Wang, who is one of the best judges, will ___2___ (invite) to give a short talk first. Everyone hopes that they will have ___3___ (chance) to show their talents. After the contest, the winners ___4___ (award) with prizes and certificates. Many parents will come to watch, ___5___ (making) the hall full of warmth.
answer: to prepare; be invited; chances; will be awarded; making
solution: 语法填空题：① to prepare 作目的状语；② will be invited 被动语态（王老师被邀请）；③ chances 复数名词；④ will be awarded 被动语态将来时；⑤ making 现在分词作结果状语。

stem:
【语法填空·提示词】用所给词的适当形式填空（每空一词）。
The scientist gave a speech about the importance ___1___ (protect) endangered animals. He showed a short film ___2___ (make) by his team last year, which moved the audience to tears. After listening to his speech, many students decided ___3___ (join) the local wildlife protection group. As a result, more and more young people ___4___ (become) interested in nature conservation. "Our planet is our home," the scientist said, ___5___ (mean) that everyone should take action.
answer: of protecting; made; to join; have become; meaning
solution: 语法填空题：① of protecting 介词+动名词（the importance of doing）；② made 过去分词作后置定语修饰 film；③ to join decide to do 不定式；④ have become 现在完成时；⑤ meaning 现在分词作伴随状语。

stem:
【语法填空·提示词】用所给词的适当形式填空（每空一词）。
The book ___1___ (write) by Mo Yan has been translated into many languages. In his novels, the stories ___2___ (set) in rural China often touch readers' hearts. Mo Yan once said that he was deeply ___3___ (influence) by his grandmother's stories when he was a child. Now he is widely ___4___ (consider) as one of the greatest writers of our time. His works, which are full of love for the Chinese countryside, ___5___ (praise) by readers both at home and abroad.
answer: written; set; influenced; considered; are praised
solution: 语法填空题：① written 过去分词作定语（被动、完成）；② set 过去分词作定语（be set in）；③ influenced 过去分词作表语；④ considered 过去分词作表语；⑤ are praised 被动语态一般现在时。

【语法填空·提示词】用所给词的适当形式填空（每空一词）。
The teacher praised the students ___1___ had finished the project on time. The project, ___2___ was about the history of our school, took them two months to complete. They interviewed some teachers ___3___ had worked here for more than twenty years and collected a lot of old photos. The headmaster was so pleased ___4___ he decided to put the photos on the school website. Now the website ___5___ (visit) by thousands of alumni every year.
answer: who; which; who/that; that; is visited
solution: 语法填空题：① who/that 限制性定语从句指人；② which 非限制性定语从句指物；③ who/that 限制性定语从句指人；④ that so... he satisfied... that... 结果状语从句；⑤ is visited 被动语态一般现在时。

【语法填空·提示词】用所给词的适当形式填空（每空一词）。
Yesterday my best friend told me that she ___1___ (visit) Hong Kong the next month. She said that she ___2___ (never / try) dim sum before, so she was really looking forward to it. Her parents promised that they ___4___ (buy) her a nice present on her birthday. She also said that her cousin ___5___ (meet) her at the airport when she arrived. I was excited to hear the news and decided that I ___5___ (write) her a letter before she left.
answer: would visit; had never tried; would buy; would meet; would write
solution: 语法填空题：① would visit 过去将来时（从句时间状语为 the next month 表明从过去看未来）；② had never tried 过去完成时；③ would buy 过去将来时；④ would meet 过去将来时；⑤ would write 过去将来时。

answer: has been built; has been used; will be completed; will be; have been waiting
solution: 语法填空题：① has been built 现在完成被动；② has been used 现在完成被动；③ will be completed 将来时被动；④ will be 一般将来时；⑤ have been waiting 现在完成进行时强调持续。

After that, they need to ___3___ (read) as much as possible in that language. Watching English movies can also help, because it improves both their listening and ___4___ (speaking) skills. The most important thing is to keep practising every day, ___5___ (making) sure that you never lose what you have learnt.
solution: 语法填空题：① Learning 动名词作主语（泛指学习）；② Mastering 动名词作主语（掌握语法规则）；③ read need 后用动词原形；④ speaking 名词性作 listening and speaking 的对应；⑤ making 现在分词作伴随状语。

He avoids ___2___ (going) to noisy places because he likes quiet surroundings. ___3___ (Practising) the piano every day is something he never forgets. solution: 语法填空题：① listening enjoy 后接动名词；② going avoid 后接动名词；③ Practising 动名词作主语；④ to join encourage sb to do 不定式；⑤ lead will 后接动词原形。

【语法填空·无提示词】根据上下文填入适当的词（每空一词）。
Yesterday our geography teacher told us that the earth ___1___ around the sun. He also said that the moon ___2___ around the earth once a month. Dear Tom,
I am sorry to hear that you are under great pressure and can't sleep well at night. Here are some suggestions that may help you.

I hope these suggestions will be useful to you. Best wishes!
Yours,
Li Hua
